scope: Reached continuable 0x406d1388 thread-name notification, four-word packet with type0x1000 and flags0. This dispatches to original handlers; it is not a debugger-consumed no-op or general SEH implementation.
dispatch: Read the current thread FS:[0] chain with bounded ascending stack-frame validation; construct guest EXCEPTION_RECORD and x86 CONTEXT_CONTROL|CONTEXT_INTEGER in checked guest stack scratch; enter each finite original handler via cdecl with record/frame/context/dispatcher arguments. Continue only if the original handler returns ExceptionContinueExecution and retains the context; ContinueSearch advances to the next frame.
context: Declared continuation point is the original guest API return PC and post-stdcall ESP. Integer registers/EFLAGS/EBP preserved, flat user control selectors CS1b/SS23; floating/debug/segment context sections are not advertised.
limits: Other exception codes/flags/packets and unhandled notifications stop explicitly.
Unwind/nested dispositions and context edits remain unsupported.
Native faults are not converted to guest exceptions.
No debugger is attached or represented; the thread name is logged diagnostically after the original handler continues.
